items.title: China plans to tighten export controls on open-weight models and 23 key AI technologies
items.summary: China plans to restrict exports of 23 key AI technologies, including model weights, source code, and training methods for systems hitting 10^26 FLOPs or 2 trillion parameters. A fast-track rule will still clear open-source releases as soon as they are registered, but the move will likely push Western companies to double down on US open-weight models over Chinese alternatives. The article China plans to tighten export controls on open-weight models and 23 key AI technologies appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 中國計畫限制 23 項關鍵人工智慧技術的出口，包含算力達到 10^26 FLOPs 或參數達到 2 兆的系統之模型權重、原始碼與訓練方法。一項快速通道規則仍將在開源版本註冊後立即予以放行，但此舉很可能會促使西方企業加倍押注美國的開源權重模型，而非中國的替代方案。這篇文章《China plans to tighten export controls on open-weight models and 23 key AI technologies》首次發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: Google's Gemini 4 Argon is closer to the AI frontier than any Google model in months
items.summary: Google Deepmind's Gemini 4 Argon scored 97.5 percent on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark, making Google the second lab after OpenAI to cross the 95 percent mark. But the results swing wildly depending on the test setup: in the standard harness, the score drops to just 49.8 percent. Argon also trails rivals in math and software engineering. The article Google's Gemini 4 Argon is closer to the AI frontier than any Google model in months appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Is AI interpretability close to a breakthrough? A new essay has researchers divided
items.summary: Neural networks may be much easier to read than researchers assumed, with about 90 percent of neurons serving a clear function. That would be big news for AI safety research, since deception or dangerous behavior could be spotted directly in a model's circuits. Researchers are still debating whether the thesis holds up. The article Is AI interpretability close to a breakthrough? A new essay has researchers divided appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 神經網路可能比研究人員原本假設的更容易解讀，大約有 90% 的神經元具有明確的功能。這對 AI 安全研究來說會是一大好消息，因為欺騙或危險行為可以直接在模型的電路中被發現。研究人員仍在爭論這個論點是否站得住腳。《AI 可解釋性是否接近突破？一篇新論文讓研究人員意見分歧》一文最先出現在 The Decoder 上。

The post Liquid AI Releases d1-ultra: A Multimodal Decision Model That Scores 65 on the AA Decision Index appeared first on MarkTechPost .

items_ai.title: China plans to tighten export controls on open-weight models and 23 key AI technologies
items_ai.summary: China plans to restrict exports of 23 key AI technologies, including model weights, source code, and training methods for systems hitting 10^26 FLOPs or 2 trillion parameters. A fast-track rule will still clear open-source releases as soon as they are registered, but the move will likely push Western companies to double down on US open-weight models over Chinese alternatives. The article China plans to tighten export controls on open-weight models and 23 key AI technologies appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 中國計畫限制 23 項關鍵人工智慧技術的出口，包含算力達到 10^26 FLOPs 或參數達到 2 兆的系統之模型權重、原始碼與訓練方法。一項快速通道規則仍將在開源版本註冊後立即予以放行，但此舉很可能會促使西方企業加倍押注美國的開源權重模型，而非中國的替代方案。這篇文章《China plans to tighten export controls on open-weight models and 23 key AI technologies》首次發表於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: Google's Gemini 4 Argon is closer to the AI frontier than any Google model in months
items_ai.summary: Google Deepmind's Gemini 4 Argon scored 97.5 percent on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark, making Google the second lab after OpenAI to cross the 95 percent mark. But the results swing wildly depending on the test setup: in the standard harness, the score drops to just 49.8 percent. Argon also trails rivals in math and software engineering. The article Google's Gemini 4 Argon is closer to the AI frontier than any Google model in months appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Google Deepmind 的 Gemini 4 Argon 在 ARC-AGI-3 基準測試中獲得 97.5% 的分數，這使 Google 成為繼 OpenAI 之後第二個突破 95% 門檻的實驗室。但測試結果會根據測試設定而大幅波動：在標準測試框架中，分數暴跌至僅 49.8%。Argon 在數學和軟體工程方面也落後於競爭對手。這篇名為《Google's Gemini 4 Argon 比數月來任何 Google 模型都更接近 AI 前沿》的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: Is AI interpretability close to a breakthrough? A new essay has researchers divided
items_ai.summary: Neural networks may be much easier to read than researchers assumed, with about 90 percent of neurons serving a clear function. That would be big news for AI safety research, since deception or dangerous behavior could be spotted directly in a model's circuits. Researchers are still debating whether the thesis holds up. The article Is AI interpretability close to a breakthrough? A new essay has researchers divided appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 神經網路可能比研究人員原本假設的更容易解讀，大約有 90% 的神經元具有明確的功能。這對 AI 安全研究來說會是一大好消息，因為欺騙或危險行為可以直接在模型的電路中被發現。研究人員仍在爭論這個論點是否站得住腳。《AI 可解釋性是否接近突破？一篇新論文讓研究人員意見分歧》一文最先出現在 The Decoder 上。
